scripts.build: npm run check:mp && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.check:mp: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!p.dependencies || !p.dependencies['@mercadopago/sdk-react']) throw new Error('Mercado Pago SDK ausente do package.json'); console.log('Mercado Pago SDK configurado:', p.dependencies['@mercadopago/sdk-react'])"
